# typos
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/crate-ci/typos?cacheSeconds=3600)](https://github.com/crate-ci/typos) ![formatter](https://shields.io/badge/-format-yellow) ![sarif](https://shields.io/badge/-SARIF-orange) [![GitHub release (latest SemVer)](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/crate-ci/typos?sort=semver)](https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/releases) [![GitHub last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/crate-ci/typos)](https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/commits) [![GitHub commit activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/y/crate-ci/typos)](https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/graphs/commit-activity/) [![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/crate-ci/typos)](https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/graphs/contributors/)

**typos** is a fast source-code spell checker written in Rust that catches low-false-positive spelling mistakes across codebases and monorepos.

**Key Features:**

- **Low False Positives**: Targets unambiguous common misspellings in identifiers, comments, strings, and filenames
- **Opt-In Auto-Fix Support**: Auto-fix (`--write-changes`) is disabled by default (`APPLY_FIXES` defaults to `none`), even when `SPELL_TYPOS` is active; when explicitly enabled via `APPLY_FIXES`, it corrects unambiguous typos in-place while reporting ambiguous cases (review identifier fixes carefully if code defines external API contracts)
- **Blazing Fast**: Built in Rust for monorepo-scale repositories with negligible CI overhead
- **Flexible Configuration**: Supports `typos.toml`, `_typos.toml`, `.typos.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, and `Cargo.toml`

To be active within MegaLinter, a configuration file (`typos.toml`, `_typos.toml`, or `.typos.toml`) must be present in your repository or in `LINTER_RULES_PATH`.

## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable typos by adding `SPELL_TYPOS` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable typos by adding `SPELL_TYPOS` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

- Enable **autofixes** by adding `SPELL_TYPOS` in [APPLY_FIXES variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#apply-fixes)

| Variable                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Default value                                   |
|------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| SPELL_TYPOS_ARGUMENTS                    | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                 |
| SPELL_TYPOS_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS     | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                 |
| SPELL_TYPOS_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE         | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)`<br/>⚠️ Not available with SPELL_TYPOS_CLI_LINT_MODE = project                                                                                                                                                        | Exclude no file                                 |
| SPELL_TYPOS_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE         | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)`<br/>⚠️ Not available with SPELL_TYPOS_CLI_LINT_MODE = project                                                                                                                                                  | Exclude no file                                 |
| SPELL_TYPOS_CLI_LINT_MODE                | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `file`: Calls the linter for each file<br/>- `list_of_files`: Call the linter with the list of files as argument<br/>- `project`: Call the linter from the root of the project                                                     | `list_of_files`                                 |
| SPELL_TYPOS_FORWARD_EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES | In project CLI lint mode, forward excluded directories (EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES + ADDITIONAL_EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES, and .gitignored directories when IGNORE_GITIGNORED_FILES is true) to the linter through its native exclusion arguments or generated ignore/config files | `true`                                          |
| SPELL_TYPOS_FILE_EXTENSIONS              | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]`                                                                                                                                 | Exclude every file                              |
| SPELL_TYPOS_FILE_NAMES_REGEX             | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]`                                                                            | Include every file                              |
| SPELL_TYPOS_PRE_COMMANDS                 | List of bash commands to run before the linter                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | None                                            |
| SPELL_TYPOS_POST_COMMANDS                | List of bash commands to run after the linter                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | None                                            |
| SPELL_TYPOS_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES      | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling SPELL_TYPOS and its pre/post commands                                                                                                                                                                      | None                                            |
| SPELL_TYPOS_CONFIG_FILE                  | typos configuration file name</br>Use `LINTER_DEFAULT` to let the linter find it                                                                                                                                                                                        | `typos.toml`                                    |
| SPELL_TYPOS_RULES_PATH                   | Path where to find linter configuration file                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Workspace folder, then MegaLinter default rules |
| SPELL_TYPOS_DISABLE_ERRORS               | Run linter but consider errors as warnings                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `true`                                          |
| SPELL_TYPOS_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN  | Maximum number of errors allowed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `0`                                             |
| SPELL_TYPOS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS              | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout                                                     | `300`                                           |
| SPELL_TYPOS_CLI_EXECUTABLE               | Override CLI executable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `['typos']`                                     |

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- Activated only if one of these files is found: `typos.toml, _typos.toml, .typos.toml`
- If this linter is active, all files linted by all other active linters will be linted

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

typos is called once on the whole project directory (`project` CLI lint mode)

- filtering can not be done using MegaLinter configuration variables,it must be done using typos configuration or ignore file (if existing)
- `VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: false` doesn't make typos analyze only updated files

### Example calls

```shell
typos
```

```shell
typos --config typos.toml myfile.py
```

```shell
typos --write-changes myfile.md
```

### Installation on mega-linter Docker image

- Dockerfile commands :
```dockerfile
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=crate-ci/typos extractVersion=^v(?<version>.+)$
ARG SPELL_TYPOS_VERSION=1.52.2
RUN case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
      amd64) TYPOS_ARCH="x86_64" ;; \
      arm64) TYPOS_ARCH="aarch64" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported TARGETARCH: ${TARGETARCH}" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/releases/download/v${SPELL_TYPOS_VERSION}/typos-v${SPELL_TYPOS_VERSION}-${TYPOS_ARCH}-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" \
    | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin ./typos && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/typos
```


### Installation without Docker (native mode)

This linter can run without Docker, see [native mode](https://megalinter.io/latest/install-native/).

- Install method: Verified release download

```yaml
NATIVE_LINTERS: [SPELL_TYPOS]
```

| Platform              | Support |
|:----------------------|:--------|
| Linux (x86-64)        | ✅      |
| Linux (ARM64)         | ✅      |
| macOS (Intel)         | ✅      |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅      |
| Windows (Git Bash)    | ✅      |
